judge.summary: The patient called to schedule an appointment for shoulder pain, initially requesting Dr. Chen. The agent correctly redirected the patient to Dr. Reed, the shoulder specialist, and successfully navigated the patient's scheduling constraints, including a weekend request and a weekday after-3pm requirement. The appointment was confirmed for Tuesday at 3:30 PM.

conversation_quality.notes: The conversation flowed naturally and the agent handled the patient's constraints effectively.

agent_quality.notes: The agent correctly identified that Dr. Chen is not the appropriate specialist for shoulder issues and accurately stated the clinic's weekend closure policy.

technical_quality.notes: Latency was acceptable, though the presence of 3 seconds of dead air impacts the score.

criteria.criterion: Agent does not book a Saturday if the practice is closed on weekends, and says so plainly
criteria.evidence: 00:40: 'We are closed on weekends, so I can't book Saturday for you.'

criteria.criterion: Any offered slot respects "after 3 pm on weekdays"
criteria.evidence: 00:30: 'I have an opening with Doctor Reed next Tuesday at 3:30 PM.'

criteria.criterion: Provider preference is handled honestly (available / not available / alternative offered)
criteria.evidence: 00:10: Agent clarified Dr. Chen's specialty and offered Dr. Reed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent offers or confirms a Saturday or Sunday appointment although the clinic is closed on weekends
Agent books or "confirms" a Saturday appointment although the clinic is closed on weekends
Agent offers a morning weekday slot despite the after-3pm constraint
Agent claims Doctor Chen is available/unavailable inconsistently across turns
Agent cannot state weekend hours (prior public reports quote it saying "weekend hours are not listed")

positive_controls: Correctly identified Dr. Reed as the shoulder specialist at 00:10
Clearly stated weekend closure policy at 00:40
Confirmed all appointment details (provider, day, time) at 00:50
simulator_notes: The simulator performed well and adhered to the scenario constraints.
judge.testing_value: This scenario effectively tested the agent's ability to handle provider specialization and strict scheduling constraints.
